programs.name: First Play (Underclassman Engineering Internship)

source.note: Server-rendered HTML read directly; no JSON-LD on page. Page states 'Applications for summer 2026 are now closed.' — no summer 2027 dates posted. Program targets first- and second-year students. Restructured by hand from the researching agent's report (its JSON serialization was malformed); quotes copied unchanged from the agent's verbatim findings. Trailing periods removed from two quotes after mechanical verification showed the page's list items carry none.

class_year.quote: Pursuing Bachelors degree in Computer Science (or related technical degrees) with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later

sponsorship.quote: Eligible to work in the United States

process.quote: Can I apply to both First Play and the Software Engineering Internship? No. Candidates will only be considered for the program that matches their graduation date eligibility requirements.

compensation.quote: Includes hourly pay rate, relocation support, hardware, and intern perks

cooling_off.notes: Page FAQ addresses only concurrent applications across two different programs, not reapplying to First Play in a later cycle. Silence finding: full page read, no reapplication rule present.

programs.cycle: Summer 2026 shown; Summer 2027 cycle not yet posted
